name: Dispel Evil and Good

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage on attacks against you.
text: You can end the spell with a Magic action to free a touched creature from possession or from being Charmed or Frightened by such creatures, or to make one such creature within 5 ft make a Cha save or be sent home (Undead to the Shadowfell, Fey to the Feywild).
